help: raise the PR for a branch from the issues it aims to complete - the title the central issue's verbatim copy, the why section one aim line per issue, both generated, so that no aim is written by hand; the body file carries the Signature and the what, how and to sections

args.name: issue
args.help: the issues the PR aims to complete, by number, the central one first - its title becomes the PR's

args.name: --head
args.help: the branch the forge holds, pushed already

args.name: --body
args.help: the body as drafted - its first line the Signature, then the what, how and to sections; it carries no aim line and no why section, which the forge writes

gh issue view: reads each aimed issue's state and title; a closed issue refuses the raise, and the first issue's title becomes the PR's
gh api: reads each aimed issue's open blockers (#482); an open blocker not aimed at refuses the raise, as it would the merge
gh repo view: reads the default branch, the PR's base
gh pr create: WRITES the PR with the generated title and body (refused loudly under CORPUS_YOGA_NO_SEND)
